instructions: See docs/ratings.md. Give every season a rating on the absolute scale. Rate the player that season, never their career.

seasons.note: Peak Chiellini in a hundred-and-two-point side: the aggressive left-sided third of the best defence in Europe, and Serie A’s defender of the year.
His one fit season, in the eighty-six-point side: a left foot good enough that the dead-ball delivery alone kept him in the team.
Eighteen, quick and raw; the career settled two divisions down.

A Serie A season, not English: a 21-year-old starting for the Inter side that won the record Scudetto, already an Italy international. Rated on that evidence, which is thinner than the English seasons.
First-choice holding midfielder for Real Madrid and France at twenty-four — the destroying and the covering were elite, everything in front of the ball was not.
The treble season, and UEFA’s best player in Europe for it: genuinely in the argument for the best attacking player in the world that year.
Almost the whole of his output arrived from twenty-five yards; a limited player with one genuinely top-flight weapon.
Back after eighteen months lost to a knee injury and never quite the same runner; the passing and the movement survived it.
Arrived in January at 19 for £17m and was immediately a difference-maker in short bursts; the ceiling is higher than the season, but the season is already good.
His best English season: the outstanding attacking player in the league for the first three months before a run of injuries and a loss of nerve turned it.
A first Bayern season spent mostly at right-back and prone to the lapse; the raw defending was already better than the performances.

The best player in a relegated side, which the spec warns against over-rating — but the ball-carrying and passing were genuinely above the division, so 75 rather than the 80 his reputation that season suggests.
Physically well up to the level and a capable defender; the temperament cost his sides more than the defending won them.
Six goals for the division's worst side at 21; genuinely combative and a real aerial threat, which is ability rather than output.
A Dutch international and UEFA Cup winner with Feyenoord arriving at 33; rated as an intelligent but slowing holding midfielder, not on the reputation.
Twenty and a regular in the back four through the record run of fourteen straight clean sheets; a clear step up on the loan season.
